narr: A slow moving cold front produced training thunderstorms across parts of the region, some of which produced flash flooding in Grayson County. One severe storm also occurred in the Waco area of Central Texas.
ev: Fire and rescue reported swift water multiple feet high and several road closures in the city of Gunter, TX.
Emergency management reported that U.S. Highway 377 near the Grayson/Denton County line was impassable due to high water over the roadway.
Emergency management reported that U.S. Highway 75 at FM 902 was impassable due to high water.
Emergency management reported that floodwaters washed the top layer of asphalt off of the road near the intersection of FM 121 and Westman Road, about 2 miles west of Gunter, TX.
Emergency management reported that Hwy 289 at Whispering Winds was closed due to high water.
